title: Taking Care of Our Earth
description: Sort actions that help or hurt Earth, choose practical responses to everyday environmental problems, and draw a solution to a real problem.
learningFocus: Identify everyday actions that can help protect land, water, air, and living things.
Communicate a simple solution to an environmental problem observed at home, school, or outdoors.
adultGuidance: Name what is happening in each picture and ask who or what the action helps or harms before sorting. For the final page, help your child choose a real, familiar problem and explain how their proposed action could help, without implying that one small action solves the whole environmental issue.

seo.title: Taking Care of Our Earth Worksheets | Learning Made Simple
seo.description: Three free Kindergarten science activities for identifying helpful actions and communicating simple solutions to environmental problems.
